semiconductor_relevance: High — EUMETRYS SAS provides specialized equipment and services for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in particle inspection and metrology.
summary: EUMETRYS SAS specializes in the distribution of advanced semiconductor equipment across Europe, focusing on particle inspection systems and metrology solutions for various substrates. They offer a range of services including equipment repair and maintenance, ensuring optimal performance in semiconductor fabs.
capabilities: Laser scanning particle inspection systems for unpatterned wafers

regional_presence.Europe: EUMETRYS SAS exclusively distributes its equipment in Europe, catering to the needs of local semiconductor fabs.
